name: stats_calculator
label: Stats
subtitle: Statistical tests with effect sizes, power and publication-style reporting
about: Run statistical tests on your data: t-tests, non-parametric tests, ANOVA, correlations and contingency tables, with effect sizes, power, post-hoc comparisons and multiple-comparison correction.
description: SciTeX Stats is a browser-based statistics app built on the scitex-stats package. Enter or open data, pick a test and read the result: statistic, p-value, effect size, power and a publication-ready summary line. Post-hoc comparisons (Tukey HSD, Games-Howell, Dunnett) and multiple-comparison corrections (Bonferroni, Holm, Sidak, FDR) are included.
ai_hint: Stats app: run statistical tests (t-test, Mann-Whitney, ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis, correlations, chi-square) with effect sizes and APA-style output.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: Run 17 statistical tests through one dispatcher
Effect sizes (Cohen's d, eta-squared, Cliff's delta, Cramer's V)
Post-hoc pairwise comparisons (Tukey HSD, Games-Howell, Dunnett)
